payload.body: **ST0001 WP06 done (4dca17f, local).** tag and tags (check, show, edit, apply, render, index) run natively; no bin/ or lib/ file touched (D3). **Your condition is met:** reindex calls the native tags render, cli::DELEGATES no longer holds (reindex, tags), and both reindex goldens are back in the replay and match. DELEGATES now holds (tag, contact) instead: tag re-renders (Contact).md through the quiet fallback (contact render >/dev/null, as pplr_tag did) until WP07, which takes the row out. **YAML reader:** src/yaml.rs, no dependency, its choice and evidence recorded in WP06's body (the maintained crates read YAML 1.2, where a bare no is the string no and there is no date; tags.py used every value through str(), so the types must be PyYAML's). It reads the subset pplr's files use and refuses block scalars, anchors, tags and documents by line. **Evidence, from a scratch worktree:** fmt, clippy -D warnings, cargo test (66 unit, 20 integration) green; golden replay 23 of 54 native, all match, the six tags cases and both reindex cases among them (so tags.yaml, the _tags pages, the Tags lines and tags_index.json are byte-identical); bats 101/101 on Rust and on legacy; AT-06.1 (to-write, red, green) covers AC-06.1; wp gate PASS; claim released. Two scaffold tests that faked a legacy tag script now fake contact, which stays on the fallback until WP07. **For review:** tags.rs keeps tags.py's own header reader (header_field) beside about.rs's engine reader, because their outputs differ on edge input; WP13 can unify them once nothing is compared against the legacy. Next: WP07 (contact cadence), which also clears DELEGATES.
